opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage as a paid participation system, beginning with a required registration payment: "upon registration what is necessary is 400 tronex we pay 400 tronex." Its earnings mechanism depends on personally recruited participants; the speaker states that in X3, "you will only earn if these are your directly referred partners." Payments from those referrals are then used to reopen slots, causing earnings to repeat. The structure also pressures continued participation, explaining that viewers can earn only one cycle at a slot "until you upgrade to slot 9," while urging them to join immediately. Against that recruitment-and-upgrade model, the presentation projects "one hundred thirty thousand five hundred sixty Tronex" from an investment of "twelve thousand eight hundred Tronex." These are the speaker's promotional claims about the platform's operation and prospective returns.
